name: v4.25.0
body:
For an installation guide, refer to the [README](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/blob/main/README.md).

## 📦 Update MCP Bundle Installation
**For Claude Desktop users:**

→ [Download linkedin-mcp-server-v4.25.0.mcpb](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/releases/download/v4.25.0/linkedin-mcp-server-v4.25.0.mcpb)

Then click the downloaded file to install in Claude Desktop.

> **Note:** MCP Bundles do not auto-update. You need to download and install the latest `.mcpb` file for each new release.

## 🐳 Update Docker Installation
**For users with Docker-based MCP client configurations:**
```bash
docker pull stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server:latest
```
The `latest` tag will always point to the most recent release.
To pull this specific version, run:
```bash
docker pull stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server:4.25.0
```


<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v4.25.0 -->

## What's Changed
### 🚀 Features
* feat(jobs): Report search total and promoted jobs by @shbernal in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/976
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* fix(daemon): Report startup log path by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1022
* fix(daemon): Refresh lookup after spawn by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1023
* fix(daemon): Settle owner election safely by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1021
* fix(jobs): Ignore no-match recommendations by @shbernal in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/974
* fix(jobs): Keep More jobs references on postings by @shbernal in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/975
* fix(ci): Allow model-only attribution by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1039
* fix(ci): Allow unpunctuated model attribution by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1041
* fix(feed): Report listener cleanup failures by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1049
* fix(search): Encode job filter tokens by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1053
* fix(jobs): Say where dropped filters go on redesign by @shbernal in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1034
* fix(jobs): Wait for job description to load by @shbernal in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/959
* fix(tools): Validate references before startup by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/841
* fix: don't block invite note on Premium banner presence alone by @3XCeptional in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1067
